definitions.explanation: A glossy sweet-savory sauce of soy sauce, sugar, and starch, brushed over grilled {団子|だんご} (dumplings) skewers. Short for みたらし{団子|だんご}, the sauce is also used as a general name for the dish itself.

examples.japanese: みたらし⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
みたらし⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦たれ→タレ：10500_tare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{甘辛|あまから}い→甘辛い：27507_amakarai⟧。
examples.english: The mitarashi glaze is sweet and savory.

examples.japanese: ⟦{屋台|やたい}→屋台：10549_yatai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{焼|や}きたて→焼きたて：16735_yakitate⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧みたらし⟦{団子|だんご}→団子：04959_dango⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought freshly grilled mitarashi dango from a food stall.

notes:
みたらし is the sweet-savory soy glaze brushed on grilled ⟦{団子|だんご}→団子：04959_dango⟧, and by extension the common short name for みたらし⟦{団子|だんご}→団子：04959_dango⟧ itself.

ETYMOLOGY:
Said to derive from {御手洗|みたらし}, the Mitarashi pond at Shimogamo Shrine in Kyoto — the skewered balls are said to imitate the bubbles rising in it.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- みたらし⟦{団子|だんご}→団子：04959_dango⟧: mitarashi dango (the full dish)
- みたらし⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦たれ→タレ：10500_tare⟧: mitarashi sauce/glaze
- みたらし⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧: mitarashi flavor (used for other snacks too, like みたらし⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧せんべい)
